description: This Java class, DriverFactory, provides a thread-safe factory for creating, retrieving, and quitting Selenium WebDriver instances configured for Chrome. It supports headless and headed modes, manages driver lifecycle, and applies browser options for stability and CI environments.

classes.name: DriverFactory
classes.description: A utility class for creating and managing WebDriver instances in a thread-safe manner. Supports Chrome browser with configurations for headless and headed modes, along with stability flags for CI environments.

methods.name: initDriver
methods.description: Initializes a new WebDriver with Chrome options based on configuration, stores it in ThreadLocal, and returns the instance.

methods.name: getDriver
methods.description: Retrieves the current thread's WebDriver instance, throws an exception if not initialized.

methods.name: quitDriver
methods.description: Quits and removes the current thread's WebDriver instance.

methods.name: buildChromeOptions
methods.description: Constructs and returns ChromeOptions configured with headless mode and stability flags based on environment.
